name: Anytype
description: Anytype is an encrypted, local-first collaborative workspace for notes, objects, databases, files and chat. People use typed objects, properties, collections, templates and spaces to organize private knowledge while retaining device-local authority.
agentUseSummary: Bind one source host and dedicated Anytype API key, then let selected agents use 46 stable JSON Local API operations through bounded read and management wrappers.

credentialRequirements.name: ANYTYPE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Anytype API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated API key in Anytype settings and store it encrypted in Relay.

credentialRequirements.name: ANYTYPE_SOURCE_HOST_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Source host ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select the exact connected host running Anytype Desktop or Anytype CLI.

credentialRequirements.name: ANYTYPE_RUNTIME
credentialRequirements.label: Anytype runtime
credentialRequirements.helpText: Choose desktop or cli so Relay pins the provider-local API port.

capabilities.label: Read local-first knowledge
capabilities.description: Search and read bounded spaces, objects, chats, lists, members, properties, tags, types, and templates.

capabilities.label: Manage local-first knowledge
capabilities.description: Create, update, archive, organize, and collaborate through stable JSON space, chat, list, object, property, tag, and type operations.

allowed.label: Read Anytype knowledge
allowed.description: Run one bounded, enumerated read against the selected source host's Anytype Local API.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Anytype knowledge
approvalRequired.description: Run one bounded, enumerated Anytype mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary Anytype APIs
blocked.description: Agents choose only enumerated versioned JSON operations; raw paths, methods, auth, files, streams, and experimental endpoints are unavailable.

blocked.label: Expose local authority
blocked.description: The API key and provider-local origin remain outside tool inputs, results, logs, and audits.

blocked.label: Transfer unbounded vault data
blocked.description: Requests, responses, arrays, strings, and nesting remain inside Relay bounds.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every Anytype mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All selected stable JSON operations run without Relay per-action approval; source-host binding, API version, provider authority, allowlists, bounds, redaction, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway persists encrypted policy and dispatches fixed versioned Local API operations only to the exact connected source host.

providerSetup.blocker: No signed-in Anytype runtime, dedicated API key, or source-host session was available for live action verification.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer creates a dedicated Anytype API key, selects the exact connected source host and desktop or CLI runtime, then verifies health, bounded reads, Safe mutation approval, a reversible Dangerous mutation, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Anytype documents its current versioned Local API and headless CLI for local-first automation.
The official 2025-11-08 reference documents search, spaces, chat, files, lists, members, objects, properties, tags, types, and templates.
The official changelog documents the stable JSON surface, 2025-11-08 header, June 2026 chat endpoints, May 2026 files, and provider rate limits.
Anytype documents user-created bearer API keys and the interactive challenge flow; Relay requires an already-created dedicated key and does not automate consent.
Anytype's official MCP confirms the Local API integration model; Relay does not mount the raw MCP and instead exposes bounded operation wrappers.
